key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which panel box the indicator is placed in.

key.name: show-previous
key.summary: Show the previous button in the panel

key.name: show-play-pause
key.summary: Show the play/pause button in the panel

key.name: show-next
key.summary: Show the next button in the panel

key.name: show-seek-backward
key.summary: Show the skip-backward button in the panel
key.description: Only shown for players that support seeking. Skips by seek-step-seconds.

key.name: show-seek-forward
key.summary: Show the skip-forward button in the panel
key.description: Only shown for players that support seeking. Skips by seek-step-seconds.

key.name: show-player-icon
key.summary: Show the player's application icon in the panel

key.name: show-title
key.summary: Show the track title in the panel

key.name: show-artist
key.summary: Show the artist in the panel

key.name: panel-text-width
key.summary: Width of the panel text, in pixels
key.description: The track text always occupies this width. Text that does not fit is truncated with an ellipsis, or scrolled when scroll-text is set.

key.name: scroll-text
key.summary: Scroll panel text that does not fit
key.description: Text wider than panel-text-width loops past it instead of being truncated.

key.name: scroll-speed
key.summary: Scrolling speed in pixels per second

key.name: controls-on-left
key.summary: Place the playback controls before the text

key.name: hide-when-inactive
key.summary: Hide the indicator when no player is running

key.name: card-show-art
key.summary: Show album art in the card

key.name: card-show-seek-bar
key.summary: Show the seek bar in the card

key.name: card-show-seek-buttons
key.summary: Show the skip-back and skip-forward buttons in the card

key.name: seek-step-seconds
key.summary: Seconds skipped by the seek buttons
